title: 相位陣列天線收發模組
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究相位排列、空間取樣與校準；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate phase progression, spatial sampling and calibration. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

stages.title: 陣列幾何
stages.description: 以三個技術單元逐一建立「陣列幾何」的模型和可反駁的驗證證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units build models and falsifiable verification evidence for array geometry.

steps.title: 座標與波前：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Coordinates and wavefront: model and design
steps.objective: 以「座標與波前」建立可檢驗的模型，明確標出座標、變數、單位和有效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable model for coordinates and wavefront, stating coordinates, variables, units and validity bounds.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅的概念示範，再排列本單元的元件、能量或資料路徑。入射角決定相鄰單元路徑差，角度基準需一致。 畫出基準與改變一個參數後的兩個狀態；用「以正負角度檢查延遲及相位符號。」提出可被推翻的預測。另列未量測條件，勿把動畫位置當真實尺寸。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor concept demonstration, then arrange this unit’s components, energy or data paths. Arrival angle sets adjacent-element path difference and requires a consistent reference. Draw baseline and one-parameter-changed states. Form a falsifiable prediction using: Check delay and phase signs for positive and negative angles. List unmeasured conditions; animation positions are not physical dimensions.
steps.check: 提交「座標與波前」兩狀態圖、變數單位表和預期差異；以本步判別方法說明何種結果會推翻模型。

steps.observation: 以正負角度檢查延遲及相位符號。
steps.observationEn: Check delay and phase signs for positive and negative angles.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：從端射與正前方量角可不換公式。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。

knowledge.title: 課程量化模型與適用界限
knowledge.titleEn: Course quantitative model and validity limits
knowledge.text: Δφ=−2π(d/λ)sinθ；θ 自正前方量起，符號依座標約定。 遠場、均勻直線陣列和窄頻近似；不含互耦或單元方向圖。
knowledge.textEn: Δφ=−2π(d/λ)sinθ; θ is from broadside and sign depends on convention. Far-field uniform linear array, narrowband approximation; excludes mutual coupling and element patterns.

steps.title: 座標與波前：量測與判別
steps.titleEn: Coordinates and wavefront: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 以「座標與波前」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。

steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。以正負角度檢查延遲及相位符號。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「入射角決定相鄰單元路徑差，角度基準需一致。」和待排除假說「從端射與正前方量角可不換公式。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. Check delay and phase signs for positive and negative angles. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “Arrival angle sets adjacent-element path difference and requires a consistent reference.” with the hypothesis to reject “Endfire and broadside angles use the same formula unchanged.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.

steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: Check delay and phase signs for positive and negative angles. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 以正負角度檢查延遲及相位符號。
steps.observationEn: Check delay and phase signs for positive and negative angles.

options: 陣列因子就是完整實體天線方向圖。
將單元方向圖與陣列因子相乘比較掃描損失。
相位位數只影響數位控制，不影響方向圖。
optionsEn: The array factor is the complete physical antenna pattern.
Multiply element pattern and array factor to compare scan loss.
Phase bits affect only digital control, not patterns.
quiz.explanation: 總方向圖包含單元方向圖與陣列因子，不能只看理想點源。 將單元方向圖與陣列因子相乘比較掃描損失。
quiz.explanationEn: Total pattern includes element pattern and array factor, not only ideal point sources. Multiply element pattern and array factor to compare scan loss.
